newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB fixes crown 32.900/dlr, 19.000/mark.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB fixes crown 32.900/dlr, 19.000/mark.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) fixed the crown on Wednesday at 32.900 to the dollar after Tuesday's fixing at 32.991, and at 19.000 to the mark from 19.100.
The rates correspond roughly with the levels on the interbank market at 11.30 a.m. (0930 gmt) when the central bank calculates its daily fixing.

On May 27, the central bank eliminated its fluctuation band within which it would fix the crown, effectively floating the currency. It now uses the fixing only as a daily reference point reflecting the market.
The fluctuation band was dropped after the central bank was forced to intervene on numerous occasions in recent weeks to defend the crown which had been under heavy downward pressure.
